blocks.text: Karen's note on Friday leaves the premium for that quarter open. I do not want it to hold up the rest of the work, so this is how we will proceed until we hear from your team.

For that quarter we will use the premium on the reinsurer's statement, because it applies the rates the amended treaty now carries. That is an assumption, not a finding, and the report to {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} will say so. If your team tells us the booked figure should stand, we will rerun that treaty's comparison on it and show both results.

So that the report describes your records correctly, we still need two answers:
1. The amount booked for the quarter, which was item 1 on my earlier list.
2. Whether any entry has been posted against the quarter since, or is planned, and in which period.
Please send them to Michelle when they are ready.
